verdict.rationale: This story assumes the product is an agent-skill collection that ships a meta-skill for authoring and packaging skills. Kino AI is an agent-integrated video editor (MCP server, footage search, timeline editing), so skill authoring is outside its product category. Its video templates, including the community wish for an agent-guided template builder, are a different capability and do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection ships a meta-skill or tool that guides my agent through writing, improving, and packaging new skills
